chunks: Aaron had indeed told them earlier: "O my people, you are being only misled with this. Surely your Lord is Ar-Rahman. So follow me and obey my command."

key_terms.هَارُونُ: Aaron (peace be upon him), the brother of Moses

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Aaron say to the Israelites during the worship of the Golden Calf?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Taa-Haa, Prophet Harun (Aaron) addresses the Children of Israel during the incident of the Golden Calf, clarifying that their idolatry was a divine test (fitnah) rather than a permanent state. He urges them to follow his leadership and obey his command to repent, highlighting his role as a mediator of divine guidance even amidst their deviation. This narrative underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the continuity of prophetic authority and the concept of trial as a means of spiritual refinement.
